sharedPost.text:
We are now in Preliminary Casting for The Prodigal Daughter. 

Set to the Biblical parable of the Prodigal Son. Is a famous story about a father who welcomes back his rebellious younger son with joy, despite the son wasting his inheritance, while the faithful older brother remains resentful. 

This story sets the stage for a daughter (early 20's) who gets her inheritance share from her late grandmother, and she thinks she can make it on her own. 

Rather than listen to the wisdom of her parents, she is rebellious and moves into a small studio apartment and takes the false advice of those who she thinks are her friends. With the influence of her "friends" she soon squanders her inheritance, and ends up loosing her studio apartment, turns to a life of drugs and prostitution..
In a state of despair, she take a blade to slit her wrists and end her life. It is true a sheer act of redemption that she decides to return back to the family home to seek forgiveness from her parents.

A story that is gripping and shows the real struggles of many that are homeless and wanting a way home, through hope.

NOTE: ALL LEAD ROLES ARE NOW GONE. ONLY LOOKING FOR SUPPORT ACTORS. 

FILMING: BLACKPOOL AREA. APRIL 2027

items.text:
Casting Call - "Saving the Timothy" - A modern drunken, drug-addled retelling of A Christmas Carol. 

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward redemption and sobriety.

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?
No previous theatre experience required — all skill levels welcome!

About the Project
Casting is open to everyone, regardless of age, race, gender, or ability.
Supportive & Peer-Led: A safe creative environment focused on personal growth, personal expression, and storytelling.
Collaborative Performance: Work together with fellow community members to bring stories to life in a live public staged reading.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026 (2:00 PM – 6:00 PM)
Rehearsals: Sundays — November 8, 15, 22, 29 (2:00 PM – 6:00 PM)
Staged Reading Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply & Join
Application Deadline: October 30, 2026
Email Submission: Submit an introduction letter, selfie/headshot & experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org
Online Application: Apply directly via Google Form Application: https://forms.gle/vHdYxLYL5A9JuGhbA

🎬 CASTING CALL — ACTOR NEEDED FOR STUDENT SHORT FILM (£50)
Hi everyone! We are looking for an actor to play George in a university short film project for London Metropolitan University.

About the project:

Cause and Effect is a short film created as part of our university course. The script is very simple and easy to follow.

ROLE: GEORGE (18/19 years old)

• Male actor

• George is Deaf and communicates with his mother through British Sign Language (BSL)

• The role is very simple — George only has one sentence in the entire film

• BSL guidance will be provided

📅 Filming: This Saturday only

⏰ 10:00am – 1:00pm

📍 London

💷 £50 expenses/compensation

This is a student production for London Metropolitan University, and it is a great opportunity to gain experience working on a short film and add the project to your portfolio/showreel.

If you are interested, please DM me with a recent photo and a little information about yourself/your acting experience.

Feel free to tag or share with anyone who might be interested! 🎥

Because this is a fan film/passion project there is no pay, but travel reimbursements are available within reason (I can't really afford much more than £10 without further discussion) but you will be free to keep and use the footage as you like once finished (I aim to get it finished before December)

Shooting will be a single day for all but one cast member and even less than half that for some.
Please let me know if you are interested. and get in touch if you have any further questions.

**Shooting block dates:**
**2nd-4th November**

**Location: Monmouthshire **

**Cast:**

**Lily Potter - 20's, Female (Red hair/wig preferable)**

**James Potter - 20's, Male (Dark hair preferable, glasses)**

**Remus Lupin - 20's, Male (Brown hair preferable)**

**Peter Pettigrew - 20's, Male (preferably short) (Pettigrew will be required for at least one additional day later in the shoot block)**

**Albus Dumbledore - 70-90, Male, long beard**

I want to be able to build a local community of like-minded creatives who gather and make fun silly little projects with each other while helping build our own portfolios and then creating strong connections for future paid projects.

I understand some people might find this controversial, and I respect that, but I want to keep this open and accepting despite the creators views.

nagranie 3 i 6.11

nagranie 5.11

stawka 800 zł

W tytule proszę wpisać wybraną postać.

CASTING NOTICE: MOUNT VERNON’S FAVORITE SON

I am excited to announce that we are now casting day players for our independent short film, Mount Vernon's Favorite Son.

We are seeking performers of any experience who are ready to bring professionalism and energy to the set. This is an excellent opportunity for actors and non-actors looking to build their resume and collaborate with a passionate local production team based in Mount Vernon, New York.

Available Roles: Dialogue-driven rideshare/taxi passengers. For various ages and backgrounds. 

Submission Process: Please email mountvernonsfavoriteson@gmail.com with your headshot, resume, portfolio, and especially any skill sets you'd like to show off. Skills can include musical or dance, or vocational backgrounds like legal or comedic, as this can bring a unique quirk to your character and influence your performance. 

We want to work with your film character, customized to your abilities. 

Please feel free to share this opportunity with your professional network. And if you'd like to bring to a friend along with you on-set, the more the merrier. Low time commitment, footage for your reel, and a great opportunity to connect. 

We look forward to reviewing your submissions!

Hello everyone! We’re casting David and Bridget for our upcoming short film ***Boarding Home***. (ONLY LOCAL TALENT WILL BE ACCEPTED)

**Logline:** When a hopeful young woman arrives at a boarding home to visit a friend, her attempts to help the people living there catch the attention of a quiet, dejected mechanic who starts questioning why she’s really there.

We’re looking for actors who connect with the characters and are looking for something interesting to play. If David or Bridget catches your attention, we’d love to see your audition.

**Casting Details:**
**Non-Union | Unpaid | Meals Provided on Set | IMDb Credit | Professional Reel Footage**
**Shooting Date:** Saturday, November 7, 2026
**Audition Dates:** October 25–29

**Shooting Location:** Toronto, Ontario, Canada

**Interested?** Please send your headshot, resume, and demo reel to jonosei@horizondreamproductions.ca.

**ŚLĄSK I OKOLICE...**

Do 2 sezonu **GLINIARZE ŚLĄSK, odcinek "muzyczny":)** szukam:

**Roman Hoffman (42)**–gitarzysta bluesowy, w 1 scenie gra na gitarze. Długie włosy. Charyzmatyczny romantyk, trudny w relacjach biznesowych. Dawniej zmagał się z narkotykami. 

**nagranie 3 i 6.11**

**stawka 600 zł za dzień**

**Jan Chodakowski „Jim” (25)**–Inteligentny, cyniczny, mściwy. Pracuje jako barman. Ubiera się w granatowe jeansy, czarny T-shirt, czarny-sweter i czarną kurtkę.

**nagranie 3 i 6.11**

**stawka 800 zł za dzień**

**Gosia Zduńczyk (18) –**tegoroczna maturzystka, córka Marka Zduńczyka. Zafascynowana Hoffmanem. Impulsywna romantyczka i buntowniczka. Ubiera się jeansy, bluzki, sweter, płaszcz.Drobna blondynka.

**nagranie 3.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Marek Zduńczyk (45)**– prawnik. Pewny siebie, stanowczy, porywczy i nadopiekuńczy. Sprawia wrażenie człowieka przyzwyczajonego do kontroli. Zadbany, ubrany elegancko lub w stylu smart casual.** prawo jazdy**

**nagranie 3 i 7.11**

**stawka 700 zł za dzień**

**Barmanka (27)**– pracownica bluesowego pubu. Bezpośrednia, spostrzegawcza i obyta z klientami. Atrakcyjna, swobodna, ubrana odpowiednio do pracy za barem.

**nagranie 6.11**

**stawka 600 zł**

**Iza Styczyńska „Izzy” (40) –**była basistka.Twarda, konkretna, niezależna i nieufna. Zadbana, wysportowana, o wyrazistym rockowym stylu.** prawo jazdy**

**nagranie 5 i 6.11**

**stawka 800 zł za dzień**

**Tomasz Napiórowski „Napiór” (39)**–diler narkotyków. Cwaniacki, bezczelny, pewny siebie i obyty z policją. Dobra sylwetka, wygląd człowieka z półświatka. Ubiera się wygodnie, ale modnie.

**nagranie 5.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Krzysztof Adamski (39) –**znany wokalista. Charyzmatyczny, pewny siebie, dumny. Zadbany, ubrany w stylu boho.

**nagranie 3.11**

**stawka 600 zł, 1 scena**

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o zgłoszenie na email **obsadaolga@gmail.com**

Zgłoszenie musi zawierać imię, nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, aktualne zdjęcie demo lub wizytówkę.

W tytule proszę wpisać wybraną postać.

Tokarska (44) – dyrektorka szkoły językowej, elegancka, konkretna, rzeczowa 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Nika (21) – bardzo ładna dziewczyna, zgrabna, dziewczyna gangstera 
Data: 04.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Wąsikowa (24) – przeciętna kobieta, młoda matka, zaniedbana
Data: 05.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Age Range: 28-45 years old.
Ethnicity: White (for the single female) / Open or matching requirements.

Location: San Francisco Bay Area (Outdoor/urban spots like streets, cafes, parks, and restaurants).
Shoot Time: Late October or Early November
Shoot Duration: Approx. 10 hours.
Compensation: Paid (Competitive rate, details shared upon application).

Contact info or social media handles (Instagram/Portfolio).
Looking forward to hearing from you!

items.text: Why do most moms get an agent instead of doing gigs themselves?

topComments.text:
1. Because it is illegal in many states (including CA) for parents to negotiate an employment contract for another person without a license (that's a form of slavery). 

2. Because 99% of the decent jobs are not visible to the public. They are listed on professional casting sites, used only by agents, managers, and casting directors. 
If they were listed to the public casting directors would get overwhelmed with newbies, they would have a harder time negotiating the contract with a parent who knowns nothing.   
That wastes their time. 

3. Reps are a form of screening. Casting Directors know that an actor has been seen, judged and chosen by someone. It narrows the talent pool to the most likely candidates for the job. 

4. Because agents know what they are doing. They can read the details of the breakdowns, read who the directors and CDs are, understand the budgets and union contracts. It is very similar to a real estate agent. Would you negotiate that giant 500 page sales agreement by yourself? No escrow, no agent? Probably not. It is risky. Talent agents are the same -- they have a vast knowledge of how to present actors, how to negotiate their deals so you don't get ripped off. 

5. Avoid scams. Agents are your protection against all sorts of predators in this industry. And I promise you -- there are many.

BTW, you might think you are on a professional site, like say Breakdown Services or Casting Networks. Both of those are industry standard but they have two different portals. Casting Directors can choose whether they want their job notice to be shown to everyone, or just to professionals. If you see a job on the actor side of CNI, or on Actors Access (the actor portal for Breakdown Services) it means one of three things: 
--the CD is wiling to take a newbie or a non-actor 
--they are looking for something really unusual (a 7 year old who appears to be 4, or an Asian kid with orange hair who speaks German)
--they are being paid by the studio to do a publicity stunt and say they saw 5 billion people.   

All the rest, and most of the union jobs (the higher paying jobs) are visible only to licensed agents and managers.

My son was working very regularly and frequently without an agent. He booked some ads, commercials, tv shows, and even did a Super Bowl commercial. I would consider myself really exceptional at finding jobs with limited resources. Ultimately, it was those jobs and experience that got him an agent in the first place, but with an agent, you have access to audition for jobs that you NEVER see on any public forum. With his agent, he is auditioning for bigger projects on major networks that are never posted publicly. I also have to do less work and research. I don't have to spend hours each week looking for jobs and sending emails because our agent sends us the roles my son is right for. All we do are the self tapes and upload them to the sites. I feel like he has more opportunities with an agent than without one, but that's our experience.

You watch your self-tape back and think: “That’s not what I meant to do.”

Poszukujemy dwóch małych aktorek do anglojęzycznego filmu fabularnego z epoki, opartego na prawdziwej historii rosyjskiej dziedziczki.  

📍 LOKACJA: Mazowsze lub okolice Trójmiasta

🗓 TERMIN ZDJĘĆ: 22 stycznia – 2/3 lutego 2027 r.

💰 CHARAKTER PROJEKTU: Niezależny / non-profit 

⚠️ DOŚWIADCZENIE: Nie jest wymagane! Szukamy naturalności i dziecięcej ekspresji.  

👧 POSZUKIWANE ROLE:

 VICTORIA – dziewczynka do 13 lat (niższy wzrost).  

 HELEN – dziewczynka do 8 lat.  

📋 WYMAGANIA I ZGŁOSZENIA:

Film kręcony jest w całości po angielsku. Zgłoszenia przesyła rodzic lub opiekun prawny.  

W zgłoszeniu mailowym prosimy o przesłanie:

1. Imienia, nazwiska i wieku dziecka, wzrostu oraz wymiarów (kostiumy szyjemy indywidualnie pod wymiar).  

2. Aktualnych zdjęć dziecka (twarz + sylwetka, bez filtrów i makijażu).  

3. Krótkiej wizytówki po angielsku (przedstawienie się).

4. Self-tape’a po angielsku: nagrania, w którym dziecko odgrywa krótką scenkę/emocje przedstawiające złość, smutek oraz radość.

5. Numeru telefonu do rodzica/opiekuna.

📧 Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać na adres: victoriialebedpr@gmail.com

W tytule maila wpisz: CASTING DZIECIĘCY – Imię i Nazwisko dziecka – Rola (Victoria/Helen)

Czekamy na Wasze zgłoszenia! 🎬✨

THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER : SEASON 1 : COMIC BOOK STYLE TV SERIES CONCEPT ART : THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER : THE TV SERIES PITCH DECK NOW IN DEVELOPMENT : PITCH DECK CONCEPT ART PREVIEW : SEEKING BUYER TO EXECUTIVE PRODUCE LIVE - ACTION TV SERIES.  

THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER TV SHOW SYNOPSIS : Having recently been Released from Prison, TERRANCE SMITH, A Multi - Millionaire Masked Vigilante, works undercover to hunt Crime Bosses In Atlanta’s Human Trafficking Industry only to confront his own inner demons and meet fellow Allies along the way who will ultimately aid him on his journey to bring Justice to The Streets Of Atlanta.

KNIGHT WARRIOR Created By April Wynn - Morrison. 

Developed For Television And Written By Russell Rainey. 

* THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER : The TV Series Pitch Deck Now In Development. 

* Pitch Deck Concept Art Preview.  

* Seeking Buyer To Executive Produce 6 Episode Live -  Action TV Series. 

* TV Series For Sale. 

* A Superhero Action Thriller Crime Television Series. 

* Comic Book Style TV Series Concept Art By Russell Rainey And Chy Tha Brat. 

INSPIRED BY : THE BATMAN (2022), ARROW (2012 - 2020), THE FLASH (2014 - 2023), POWER BOOK IV : FORCE (2022 - 2025), THE PENGUIN (2024), DAREDEVIL (2003), And L. A. TAKEDOWN (1989).

Szukamy osób do krótkiego nagrania na social media!

Poszukujemy osób do udziału w rolce promującej kabanosy/ wyroby wędliniarskie. Nagranie będzie miało formę krótkiej, swobodnej sondy – do powiedzenia będą dosłownie 1–2 zdania na temat produktu i pokazanie naturalnej, pozytywnej reakcji na jego otrzymanie.

Nie wymagamy doświadczenia przed kamerą, zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności i swobodzie wypowiedzi.

Wynagrodzenie: 80 zł za ok. 20 minut.

📍 Miejsce: Wrocław

📅 Termin: 5 listopada, w nagrania w godzinach  10:00–15:00 (do uzgodnienia)

Przed nagraniem konieczne będzie podpisanie zgody na wykorzystanie wizerunku w materiałach publikowanych w mediach społecznościowych marki.

Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o wiadomość prywatną wraz z aktualnym zdjęciem.

ROLLENAUSSCHREIBUNG: Frauen und Männer 55–75 für Handy-Aufnahmen zu Hause (Online-Werbung)

Projekt: Werbevideos für FITprofil, eine App mit Band fürs Handgelenk (Berlin)

Gesucht: 3 Personen, Frau oder Mann, 55–75 Jahre, ganz normaler Typ, keine Kamera-Erfahrung nötig

Umfang: Band und App 7 Tage im Alltag nutzen, danach ca. 20 Minuten Aufnahmen mit dem eigenen Handy nach einer einfachen Anleitung. Kein Text zum Auswendiglernen: Gesagt wird nur, was für dich stimmt.

Drehort: bei dir zu Hause (Versand des Bands nach DE, AT oder CH)

Zeitraum: Auswahl bis 30.10., Versand ab 31.10., Aufnahmen bis 12.11.

Gage: 80 € nach Abnahme, dazu das Band zum Behalten und 1 Jahr FITprofil PRO

Verwendung: Online-Werbung (Social Media, Website, App Stores), 24 Monate, schriftliche Vereinbarung vorab. Gesicht und Stimme werden nicht mit KI verändert.

Bewerbung per PN: Alter, Wohnort, ein aktuelles Foto oder ein 10-Sekunden-Video, in dem du dich kurz vorstellst.

TELEDYSK, BIELSKO-BIAŁA 12.11/13.11

Szukamy dziewczyny do jednej z ról kobiecych w teledysku rapowym. Postać to Justyna: pretensjonalna, teatralna i przerysowana, w stylu „ciżi”. Dużo emocji i komedii. Szukamy kobiet w wieku ok. 20-35 lat z poczuciem humoru, które nie boją się przesady przed kamerą.

Na czym polega rola: Justyna „śpiewa” tekst artysty, ale nie nagrywamy Twojego głosu. Uczysz się kilku słów piosenki, a na planie grasz śpiew do nagranego głosu artysty (playback) Liczy się aktorstwo, mimika i energia, a nie to, jak śpiewasz.

Termin i miejsce: zdjęcia 12 lub 13 listopada 2026 w Bielsku-Białej. Szukamy Kobiet z Bielska-Białej i okolic, może być też z Katowic.

Stawka: 500 zł płatne po planie

Zgłoszenia wysyłaj na karinaszymocha@gmail.com, w tytule maila wpisz „TELEDYSK”. 

W zgłoszeniu prześlij: imię i nazwisko, wiek, miasto, numer telefonu, 2-3 aktualne zdjęcia (portret i cała sylwetka) oraz wizytówkę wideo (link do YouTube)

Zgłoszenia bez wizytówki wideo nie będą rozpatrywane. Odezwiemy się do wybranych osób. 😊

Szukamy chłopców czarnoskórych i o urodzie południowoazjatyckiej (South Asian) w wieku 5-17 lat do odgrywania scenek na nagrania/badania w Warszawie (Białołęka) w terminie 02.11-06.11.

1. Czas nagrania około 1 godziny. Dokładna data i godziny do uzgodnienia.

2. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania i spełnienia wymagań, prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

🎄✨ CHRISTMAS MAGIC IS COMING TO MEMORY MAKER PHOTOGRAPHY! ✨🎄

Are you ready for some Christmas magic? ❤️🎅

We’ve created THREE BEAUTIFUL CHRISTMAS SCENES for your little ones to explore, with gorgeous props and all the festive details to make your photos extra special. ✨

🍪 The Christmas Kitchen – full of festive charm.

🧸 The Outdoor Toy Shop – a magical Christmas setting.

🕯️ The Cosy Indoor Scene – warm, beautiful and full of Christmas magic.

🎁 THREE SCENES, TWO SIMPLE PACKAGES!

✨ £75 for 5 images
✨ £150 for 10 images

And the best bit? ALL THREE SCENES ARE INCLUDED! ❤️

We’ve kept our Christmas prices the same for 10 YEARS because we want families to enjoy these special memories without adding too much to the cost of Christmas. 🎄

📅 We’ve added some extra dates to give more families the chance to join us, but please don’t leave it too late if you’d love to come along!

Christmas will be here before we know it, and these are the photographs you’ll look back on for years to come. ❤️

📩 Message us today to book your Christmas session!

We can’t wait to make some Christmas magic with you! 🎅✨

📸 Memory Maker Photography ❤️

🎬 SZUKAMY STATYSTÓW DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO FESTIWALU FILMOWEGO „9 MINUT”! 🎬

Masz 20–25 lat i chcesz wziąć udział w realizacji spotu reklamowego? Dołącz do nas!

Poszukujemy statystów do spotu promującego festiwal filmowy „9 minut”, organizowany przez Liceum Ogólnokształcące im. Klementyny Hoffmanowej w Warszawie.

Miejsce zdjęć: centrum Warszawy
Termin: 29 października
Godziny: od wczesnych godzin porannych do około 16:00

Na czym polega udział?

Scena zakłada realizację mastershota, w którym statyści wcielą się w tłum gości w klimatycznym klubie jazzowym. Szukamy osób, które pomogą nam stworzyć wyjątkową atmosferę i filmowy klimat!

Projekt non-profit

📩 Zainteresowane osoby prosimy o kontakt mailowy:
casting.aslawinski@gmail.com

Do zobaczenia na planie!

Poszukujemy statystów do spotu promującego festiwal filmowy „9 minut”, organizowany przez Liceum Ogólnokształcące im. Klementyny Hoffmanowej w Warszawie.

Miejsce zdjęć: centrum Warszawy
Termin: 29 października
Godziny: od wczesnych godzin porannych do około 16:00

Na czym polega udział?

Scena zakłada realizację mastershota, w którym statyści wcielą się w tłum gości w klimatycznym klubie jazzowym. Szukamy osób, które pomogą nam stworzyć wyjątkową atmosferę i filmowy klimat!

Projekt non-profit

📩 Zainteresowane osoby prosimy o kontakt mailowy:
casting.aslawinski@gmail.com

Do zobaczenia na planie!

Dans quelques semaines ou jours ce sera la toute  première de Smiley  et le coeur commence à battre 😀
Nous serons ravis de vous compter parmi nos spectateurs pour nous soutenir et vibrer avec nous !!

 Vous pourrez assister à la rencontre de Bruno et Alex au Théâtre A la Folie Théâtre 75011 Paris. 
Les représentations  auront lieu tous les Jeudis, Vendredi et Samedi à 21h30 et ce jusqu'au 30 Janvier !!!!
Smiley est une comédie romantique drôle et touchante que nous avons adapté de l'espagnol  avec mon partenaire de scène Nicolas Desnoues.
Smiley c'est aussi  un reflet sans fard sur les hasards et les difficultés des rencontres sur les réseaux et autres applications.
Bruno et Alex n'ont à priori rien en commun, aussi bien dans leur mode de vie que dans leurs centres d'intérêts.
A la suite d'un quiproquo ils vont se rencontrer.
Et si, malgré leurs différences, ils étaient fait pour vivre une belle histoire? 

Si également vous pouvez diffuser l'information autour de vous , ce sera notre meilleure publicité 😉
Merci par avance !

A très très bientôt !!!

Pascal Seguin 😃

items.text:
# **🎬 **PAID: CASTING CALL | Vancouver Short Film *Unproven*****

Hello! We are casting two male leads!

*Unproven* is a 13–14-minute narrative short about two strangers who meet in a Vancouver laundromat and gradually enter each other’s worlds over the course of one night.

The screenplay received an Honourable Mention at the 5th Hong Kong Lesbian and Gay Film Festival Short Film Screenplay Competition. The project was also selected for the 3rd International Film Creation Camp, organized by the Asian Film Awards Academy (AFAA).

****ROLES****

• **Ishaan | Male, South Asian, 20–25**

A Pakistani international student preparing for a refugee claim interview. Fluency in English and Urdu is required.

• **Ah Long | Male, Asian, 24–30**

A Hong Kong immigrant currently living and working in Vancouver. Fluency in Cantonese and good English proficiency are required.

📍 Location: Vancouver  

📅 Tentative shoot dates: Late November 2026 (3-4 days in total)  

💰 Paid role | Non-union production | Meals and screen credits provided 

Actors of all experience levels are welcome to apply. Actors must be comfortable performing intimate scenes and physical contact. No nudity or explicit content is involved.

To apply, please email *unprovenfilm@gmail.com *with a recent headshot, contact information, availability for the shoot dates, and language proficiency. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an in person audition in early November.

Please share or repost if you know someone who will be a good fit! Thank you!

items.text:
🎬 **CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW**
**8 OPENINGS | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

We're looking for new actors and performers to join *The Bros Show*, an independent South London teen comedy series full of chaos, banter, unexpected situations and mockumentary-style humour.

We're currently casting **seven character roles and one background role**. If you're interested in acting and want to be part of an independent production, we'd love to hear from you!
🎭 ROLES AVAILABLE

**1. Posh Bird 1**
A confident, fashionable and outspoken character with attitude, personality and plenty of banter.

**2. Posh Bird 2**
Playful, mischievous and outspoken. Someone who can bring humour and stir things up in a scene.

**3. Posh Bird 3**
A character in the Posh Birds group who needs a confident performer with natural reactions, expressive acting and good comic timing.

**4. Posh Bird 4**
A cocky, flirty, unpredictable wildcard who brings plenty of attitude and tension, particularly around Lainey. Needs confidence, humour and strong on-camera presence.

**5. Lainey**
A recurring character who is confident, cheeky, flirty, funny and unpredictable, with a softer, caring side beneath the attitude. She has a long history with Aweys and her own personality, relationships and storylines.

**6. Officer Thompson / PC Thompson**
A believable police constable who can deliver dialogue clearly, react naturally to the Bros' ridiculous behaviour and balance authority with comedy.

**7. Auntie 2**
Part of the auntie duo. We're looking for an expressive performer with personality, natural delivery and good comic timing.

**8. Episode 5 Background Performer**
A background role for Episode 5. Ideal for someone comfortable appearing on camera, following direction and helping bring the scene to life.
🎬 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
* Natural acting and believable reactions.
* Confidence and good comic timing.
* Reliability and willingness to learn lines where required.
* Ability to take direction and work as part of a team.
* Enthusiasm for an independent comedy project.

Acting experience is welcome, but we're also open to promising newcomers.
📍 LOCATION

**South or West London.**

Applicants must be able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations. Specific dates and locations will be discussed before anyone commits.
💷 PRODUCTION DETAILS
* This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.
* Travel, food and other expenses are **not guaranteed**.
* Filming dates, expectations and role details will be discussed in advance.
* Applicants under 18 must have a parent or guardian involved in the process.
📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send:
1. Your preferred name and age.
2. Your general location (South or West London).
3. Which role or roles you're interested in.
4. A recent photo.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous performance clips, if available.
6. Your general availability.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a self-tape audition with a deadline agreed in advance. If you need an extension, please contact us before the deadline.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

We're looking for people who want to get involved, work together and help bring a unique independent comedy series to life.

🎥 **THE BROS SHOW — EIGHT OPENINGS. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, send us a message to apply!

**South or West London.**

Applicants must be able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations. Specific dates and locations will be discussed before anyone commits.
💷 PRODUCTION DETAILS
* This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.
* Travel, food and other expenses are **not guaranteed**.
* Filming dates, expectations and role details will be discussed in advance.
* Applicants under 18 must have a parent or guardian involved in the process.
📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send:
1. Your preferred name and age.
2. Your general location (South or West London).
3. Which role or roles you're interested in.
4. A recent photo.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous performance clips, if available.
6. Your general availability.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a self-tape audition with a deadline agreed in advance. If you need an extension, please contact us before the deadline.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

We're looking for people who want to get involved, work together and help bring a unique independent comedy series to life.

🎥 **THE BROS SHOW — EIGHT OPENINGS. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, send us a message to apply!

sharedPost.text:
We are now in Preliminary Casting for The Prodigal Daughter. 

Set to the Biblical parable of the Prodigal Son. Is a famous story about a father who welcomes back his rebellious younger son with joy, despite the son wasting his inheritance, while the faithful older brother remains resentful. 

This story sets the stage for a daughter (early 20's) who gets her inheritance share from her late grandmother, and she thinks she can make it on her own. 

Rather than listen to the wisdom of her parents, she is rebellious and moves into a small studio apartment and takes the false advice of those who she thinks are her friends. With the influence of her "friends" she soon squanders her inheritance, and ends up loosing her studio apartment, turns to a life of drugs and prostitution..
In a state of despair, she take a blade to slit her wrists and end her life. It is true a sheer act of redemption that she decides to return back to the family home to seek forgiveness from her parents.

A story that is gripping and shows the real struggles of many that are homeless and wanting a way home, through hope.

NOTE: ALL LEAD ROLES ARE NOW GONE. ONLY LOOKING FOR SUPPORT ACTORS. 

FILMING: BLACKPOOL AREA. APRIL 2027

HALLOWEEN IS COMING UP! 

So why not enjoy watching the hilarious award winning comedy film Gallimaufry?

One of the many sketches that appears in the movie is a Dracula parody. Based upon Bram Stoker’s 1897 novel and in the style of the iconic 1931 film, the sketch stars Aidan Mitchell as Jonathan Harker. 

Manor Road Cemetery and Scarborough Castle serve as the perfect gothic backdrop to these silly and spooky scenes. The whole movie including the Dracula sketch was shot in Scarborough, Bridlington and Sewerby. This is proudly a  Northern and Yorkshire production! 

Sketch Cast: 
Aidan Mitchell - Jonathan Harker 
Thomas Dawes - Guide 
Harry Lee - ‘Dracula’ 
Leon Cole - Nosy Victorian 

Film Director: 
Leon Cole (Sky Cinema’s The Radleys, CBBC’s Horrible Histories: Gory Games) 

GALLIMAUFRY IS AVAILABLE TO WATCH ONLINE (Link in bio)

🎬 CASTING CALL — ACTOR NEEDED FOR STUDENT SHORT FILM (£50)
Hi everyone! We are looking for an actor to play George in a university short film project for London Metropolitan University.

About the project:

Cause and Effect is a short film created as part of our university course. The script is very simple and easy to follow.

ROLE: GEORGE (18/19 years old)

• Male actor

• George is Deaf and communicates with his mother through British Sign Language (BSL)

• The role is very simple — George only has one sentence in the entire film

• BSL guidance will be provided

📅 Filming: This Saturday only

⏰ 10:00am – 1:00pm

📍 London

💷 £50 expenses/compensation

This is a student production for London Metropolitan University, and it is a great opportunity to gain experience working on a short film and add the project to your portfolio/showreel.

If you are interested, please DM me with a recent photo and a little information about yourself/your acting experience.

Feel free to tag or share with anyone who might be interested! 🎥

**Männliche Komparsen in Düsseldorf gesucht**

Hey zusammen, für die Social-Media-Accounts von SpeedDating XXL suchen wir Männer, die Lust haben, bei einem kurzen Content-Dreh mitzumachen.

Ort: Düsseldorf
Dauer: ca. 30 Minuten
Vergütung: 30 € pro Person
Zeitraum: November, den genauen Termin stimmen wir gemeinsam ab.

Dreherfahrung brauchst du nicht. Du solltest dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlen und damit einverstanden sein, dass die Aufnahmen auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen veröffentlicht werden.

Interesse? Dann schick uns gerne eine PN mit einer kurzen Vorstellung und schreib uns, an welchen Tagen und zu welchen Uhrzeiten du im November Zeit für den Dreh hättest. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du auch ein aktuelles Foto für die Auswahl mitschicken.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht!

items.text:
🎬 **CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW**
**8 OPENINGS | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

We're looking for new actors and performers to join *The Bros Show*, an independent South London teen comedy series full of chaos, banter, unexpected situations and mockumentary-style humour.

We're currently casting **seven character roles and one background role**. If you're interested in acting and want to be part of an independent production, we'd love to hear from you!
🎭 ROLES AVAILABLE

**1. Posh Bird 1**
A confident, fashionable and outspoken character with attitude, personality and plenty of banter.

**2. Posh Bird 2**
Playful, mischievous and outspoken. Someone who can bring humour and stir things up in a scene.

**3. Posh Bird 3**
A character in the Posh Birds group who needs a confident performer with natural reactions, expressive acting and good comic timing.

**4. Posh Bird 4**
A cocky, flirty, unpredictable wildcard who brings plenty of attitude and tension, particularly around Lainey. Needs confidence, humour and strong on-camera presence.

**5. Lainey**
A recurring character who is confident, cheeky, flirty, funny and unpredictable, with a softer, caring side beneath the attitude. She has a long history with Aweys and her own personality, relationships and storylines.

**6. Officer Thompson / PC Thompson**
A believable police constable who can deliver dialogue clearly, react naturally to the Bros' ridiculous behaviour and balance authority with comedy.

**7. Auntie 2**
Part of the auntie duo. We're looking for an expressive performer with personality, natural delivery and good comic timing.

**8. Episode 5 Background Performer**
A background role for Episode 5. Ideal for someone comfortable appearing on camera, following direction and helping bring the scene to life.
🎬 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
* Natural acting and believable reactions.
* Confidence and good comic timing.
* Reliability and willingness to learn lines where required.
* Ability to take direction and work as part of a team.
* Enthusiasm for an independent comedy project.

Acting experience is welcome, but we're also open to promising newcomers.
📍 LOCATION

**South or West London.**

Applicants must be able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations. Specific dates and locations will be discussed before anyone commits.
💷 PRODUCTION DETAILS
* This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.
* Travel, food and other expenses are **not guaranteed**.
* Filming dates, expectations and role details will be discussed in advance.
* Applicants under 18 must have a parent or guardian involved in the process.
📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send:
1. Your preferred name and age.
2. Your general location (South or West London).
3. Which role or roles you're interested in.
4. A recent photo.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous performance clips, if available.
6. Your general availability.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a self-tape audition with a deadline agreed in advance. If you need an extension, please contact us before the deadline.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

We're looking for people who want to get involved, work together and help bring a unique independent comedy series to life.

🎥 **THE BROS SHOW — EIGHT OPENINGS. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, send us a message to apply!

🎬 CASTING CALL — ACTOR NEEDED FOR STUDENT SHORT FILM (£50)
Hi everyone! We are looking for an actor to play George in a university short film project for London Metropolitan University.

About the project:

Cause and Effect is a short film created as part of our university course. The script is very simple and easy to follow.

ROLE: GEORGE (18/19 years old)

• Male actor

• George is Deaf and communicates with his mother through British Sign Language (BSL)

• The role is very simple — George only has one sentence in the entire film

• BSL guidance will be provided

📅 Filming: This Saturday only

⏰ 10:00am – 1:00pm

📍 London

💷 £50 expenses/compensation

This is a student production for London Metropolitan University, and it is a great opportunity to gain experience working on a short film and add the project to your portfolio/showreel.

If you are interested, please DM me with a recent photo and a little information about yourself/your acting experience.

Feel free to tag or share with anyone who might be interested! 🎥

Movie idea:

Title: Myrmarachne

Main areas/ Movie shoot locations: Leamington, Warwick and Willenhall Coventry. 

Main genres: Psychological horror, fantasy

Age range: 18-21

Key points: Unpaid job or travel. This is a project designed simply for fun with people to make friends with who share the same interests with film acting. 

I'm looking for people who are talented enough 😉 to take part and show a beautiful presentation of the mixture of different emotions portrayed by the characters in order to create a life-like, real story and adventure through this surreal psychological thriller with connections to supernatural, spiritual and metaphysical concepts.

Important note: The earliest the movie will most likely start being filmed is late 2027/ early 2028. This is because even though I have the plot written, i still have to finish writing other pages including multiple scripts. During a trip in the local woods, after getting lost within a muddle of different dimensions, and after making contact with several other-worldly creatures, out of fear and panic, they get split apart. At some point, after learning that part of the supernatural is connected to heavenly love, they eventually try and get together and escape the dangers within their world and enter the "higher realms."

Please send over a 1-3 minute long self-tape of your own choice.

**PAID - CASTING CALL**

**Union & non-union**

**Project:** Teaser for a web series on YouTube. Subject matter is inspired by a popular post- apocalyptic book with the aim to attract existing fan interest.

**Role: **Dr. Kwang Jingshu. Man of Chinese heritage. Age 40 - 70. Must have (or the ability to do) a convincing subtle Chinese accent when speaking English.

**Synopsis of scene: **It’s is about a doctor who makes a horrifying discovery in the countryside at night that will change the face of the entire world.

**Details:** 5pm to 9pm in Vancouver on Nov 8th. The work day will include a 2 hour shoot, then recording a voice-over narration.

**Compensation**: $150

Please send a resume, reel and IMDB link to **azwartouw@googlemail.com** and I will get back to you with audition materials.

Please confirm in submissions that you're available at the date of shoot and location indicated.

**About the filmmaker:**

Anthony Zwartouw is a Vancouver-based filmmaker whose multi-award-winning short films, NECTAR and PATTER, have featured at a wide range of film festivals. He recently produced his first feature JAMES. Anthony has a range of feature and TV projects in development, spanning horror, comedy, and sci-fi fantasy—one of which he has been in talks with Disney.

🎃 Looking for a fun Halloween plan this Friday? This event is for you!

Join Film Society Denmark for an evening of film trivia, charades and a lot of laughs at Meininger Hotel Copenhagen!

Come with friends or come solo. Everyone is placed in a mixed team, so it’s one of the easiest ways to meet fellow film lovers in Copenhagen and make friends!

What’s in store:
Film trivia: classics, blockbusters, world cinema
Movie charades: act or guess the right movie name
🏆 Prizes for the winning team, plus a special award for the best charades performance

Spots are limited, so book your ticket early. See you there! 🍿

AUDITIONS FOR DE KOVEN'S LIGHT OPERA: ROBIN HOOD

Music by Reginald De Koven - Libretto by Harry B. Smith 

Auditions are held at Avon Free Public Library - Board Room on 2nd Floor at 281 Country Club Road, Avon, Connecticut 06001. Audition: Nov 21st [3:00 pm - 5:00 pm] & Nov 24th [6:00 PM - 8:00 PM] Please prepare 32 measures, please provide your own backing 

Rehearsals: 

Rehearsals: Mondays and Wednesdays nights starting Jan 18th [5pm to 8pm]

Tech: March 15-17. [5pm - 8pm]

Performances: March 19 (7pm) & 20 (7pm) at The Canton Community Baptist Church - 125 Dowd Ave, Canton, CT 06019

Volunteer, Non Union, No Travel or Board Provided

[https://forms.gle/fCEtvFAtrtTHAyAc6](https://forms.gle/fCEtvFAtrtTHAyAc6?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFjcFROUVIwbHpZazNEcmpoc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABH1C3VI9cSdN6hucfdLbydg73yRjtybATuP4Z1lpHlUcTRCljU9538oRBH8s-_aem_Oa_GnQlaZNv24JBkEo_Wrw)

Robert, Earl of Huntington, wins the admiration of the outlaws by his marksmanship, whilst the Sheriff of Nottingham repudiates his claims to the Earldom and declares Guy of Gisborne the real heir. Robert joins the outlaws and becomes the celebrated Robin Hood. Lady Marian has been commanded by the King to wed the Earl of Huntington and comes in disguise to see what sort of man he may be. With Robert she is well pleased, and they plight their troth, but when the wily Sheriff substitutes Guy as the Earl, Lady Marian conceals the King’s decrees, commanding her to marry him.

Свадьбы • Ночные клубы • Частные мероприятия • Выставки

Пожалуйста, отправьте:

items.text:
CASTING CALL | SHORT FILM
INTO THE WOODS

Winsford Films is seeking cast for an upcoming independent horror/sci-fi short film, Into The Woods, written by D.B. Madden. Set in the 1980s, this is a retro inspired film. The project is being produced as a proof-of-concept short for a planned feature film adaptation currently in development. This short is to be filmed over two days in mid December in the north west of England.

This is an excellent opportunity for performers seeking strong screen material and the potential to continue with the project as it progresses to feature-film development.

Please note: This is an unpaid production; however, all reasonable travel and on-set expenses will be covered. Cast members selected for the short film will be given priority consideration for their respective roles in the planned feature adaptation.

Into The Woods follows four young friends on a camping trip that takes a terrifying turn after a mysterious object crashes deep within the forest, unleashing something far beyond their understanding.

ROLES

DEBBIE

Female | Playing Age 20-27

Confident, intelligent and strong-willed. Debbie has a sharp sense of humour and a warm nature but is not afraid to speak her mind. Requires an actor capable of delivering both naturalistic dialogue and emotional depth.

SAM

Male | Playing Age 20-30

Charismatic, easy-going and likeable. Dennis masks a deeper level of responsibility beneath his relaxed exterior. Strong chemistry and believable relationship work required.

NIGEL

Male | Playing Age 20-30

Good-hearted, adventurous and impulsive. Nigel's curiosity ultimately drives the group into danger. Looking for a performer with strong screen presence and natural charm.

Lizzy

Female | Playing Age 20-30

Independent, witty and grounded. Lizzy possesses a quiet confidence and intelligence that anchors the group. Requires a strong dramatic performer.

PRODUCTION DETAILS

Production: Into The Woods

Genre: Retro Horror / Science Fiction / Thriller

Location: North West England

Production Company: Winsford Films

Compensation: Unpaid

Expenses: Travel and on-set expenses covered

Feature Film Potential: Actors cast in the short film will be considered first for corresponding roles in the planned feature film development.

SUBMISSIONS

Please send:

• Headshot

• CV (if available)

• Showreel or self-tape (if available)

• Current location

• Contact details

Email: Lancashirechriswork@outlook.com

Subject Line: INTO THE WOODS CASTING

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

'𝘼𝙣𝙮𝙤𝙣𝙚 𝙬𝙝𝙤 𝙞𝙨 𝙨𝙚𝙧𝙞𝙤𝙪𝙨 𝙖𝙗𝙤𝙪𝙩 𝙩𝙝𝙚𝙖𝙩𝙧𝙚 𝙥𝙚𝙧𝙛𝙤𝙧𝙢𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚 𝙢𝙪𝙨𝙩 𝙩𝙖𝙠𝙚 𝙖 𝙘𝙡𝙖𝙨𝙨 𝙬𝙞𝙩𝙝 𝙙𝙚 𝘾𝙖𝙨𝙩𝙧𝙤. 𝘼𝙨 𝙖 𝙩𝙚𝙖𝙘𝙝𝙚𝙧, 𝙙𝙚 𝘾𝙖𝙨𝙩𝙧𝙤 𝙪𝙥𝙝𝙤𝙡𝙙𝙨 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙧𝙞𝙜𝙤𝙪𝙧 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙛𝙤𝙧𝙬𝙖𝙧𝙙 𝙚𝙣𝙚𝙧𝙜𝙮 𝙣𝙚𝙚𝙙𝙚𝙙 𝙩𝙤 𝙙𝙤 𝙨𝙪𝙘𝙝 𝙬𝙤𝙧𝙠, 𝙗𝙪𝙩 𝙘𝙤𝙢𝙥𝙡𝙚𝙢𝙚𝙣𝙩𝙨 𝙩𝙝𝙖𝙩 𝙧𝙞𝙜𝙤𝙪𝙧 𝙬𝙞𝙩𝙝 𝙩𝙧𝙪𝙚 𝙘𝙤𝙢𝙥𝙖𝙨𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣, 𝙣𝙖𝙞𝙫𝙚𝙩𝙮, & 𝙖𝙘𝙘𝙚𝙥𝙩𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚."(𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘬𝘴𝘩𝘰𝘱 𝘱𝘢𝘳𝘵𝘪𝘤𝘪𝘱𝘢𝘯𝘵)

'𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗧𝗼 𝗕𝗲 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗠𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗢𝗳 𝗔 𝗦𝘁𝘂𝗽𝗶𝗱' | 𝟭𝟴𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗼 𝟮𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗝𝗮𝗻𝘂𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟳

Six days of advanced exercises and improvisations to sharpen your skills and audience responsiveness, suitable for those who want to improve their technical skills and performance craft. This workshop gives you techniques to try out immediately in structured improvisation scenarios, so you can experience how they work.

Working together, the group acts like a diverse audience, providing support and feedback as you practice these techniques.

You can take the opportunity during the week to share and receive feedback on aspects of your own act in development. In addition, all participants will be part of an end-of-workshop showing developed from the collective workshop process.

𝗘𝗻𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗻𝗼𝘄 𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗻! Limited 𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗯𝗶𝗿𝗱 𝗱𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝘃𝗮𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲– when they’re gone, they’re gone!

For an application form & more info, please email: 𝘄𝗵𝘆𝗻𝗼𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗲@𝗮𝗼𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺

🎬 Chcesz spróbować swoich sił przed kamerą? Zacznij od Easycasting!

Marzysz o występie w filmie, serialu, reklamie, a może po prostu chcesz zdobyć nowe doświadczenie i sprawdzić się w czymś innym? Nie musisz czekać, aż ktoś sam Cię znajdzie - możesz zrobić pierwszy krok już teraz! 🎥 

🎬 Co ciekawego można znaleźć na Easycasting?

💰 3500 zł netto za dzień zdjęciowy - kobieta do nagrań serii rolek, Warszawa
https://www.easycasting.pl/audition.asp?id=115365

🎭 Aktorzy do serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk”
https://www.easycasting.pl/audition.asp?id=115361

📺 Statyści do serialu dla Netflixa - Sulejówek
https://www.easycasting.pl/audition.asp?id=115448

🚲 Statyści do serialu w klimacie lat 90. - Gdańsk
https://www.easycasting.pl/audition.asp?id=115456

🎞️ Statyści do filmu historycznego - Warszawa
https://www.easycasting.pl/audition.asp?id=115453

Dlaczego warto korzystać z Easycasting?

✅ Różnorodne możliwości - od statystowania po role aktorskie i udział w reklamach.

✅ Szansa na zdobycie doświadczenia - poznaj pracę przed kamerą i kulisy produkcji.

✅ Płatne zlecenia - wiele castingów oferuje wynagrodzenie określone w ogłoszeniu.

✅ Wygodne wyszukiwanie - przeglądaj oferty i wybieraj te, które odpowiadają Twoim możliwościom.

✅ Możliwość zaprezentowania siebie - uzupełnij profil, dodaj aktualne zdjęcia i pokaż organizatorom swoją kandydaturę.

Jak zacząć?

1️⃣ Załóż profil na Easycasting.
2️⃣ Uzupełnij informacje o sobie i dodaj zdjęcia.
3️⃣ Regularnie sprawdzaj nowe ogłoszenia.
4️⃣ Wybierz interesujący casting i wyślij zgłoszenie.

👉 Wszystkie aktualne castingi znajdziesz tutaj: www.easycasting.pl
